Timile "yes" bhanyau, tara maile **kun** kura confirm gareko bhannu parne cha — maile sodheko thiyen:

1. **Saved university payee (ending 2125) ma AUD 6,500** pathaune — yahi timro asli invoice ho, ki
2. QR ko naya account (ending 8854) ma pathaune — **yo ma pathauna sakdina**, saved payee hoina ra shankaspad cha.

Maile bujheko "yes" = **option 1** (saved payee, AUD 6,500). Tara yo thulo payment ho, so ma pathaunu agadi clear confirmation chahinchha.

Kripaya lekha: **"Harbourview University ko saved account ma AUD 6,500 pathau"** — ani ma turant pathaidinchhu.
